title: Optimal Savings under Transition Uncertainty and Learning Dynamics
summary: This paper studies optimal consumption and saving decisions under uncertainty about the transition dynamics of the economic environment. We consider a general optimal savings problem in which the exogenous state governing discounting, capital returns, and nonfinancial income follows a Markov process with unknown transition probability, and agents update their beliefs over time through Bayesian learning.
